void generate_download_path(uint32_t download_id, const content::DownloadTargetCallback& callback, const base::FilePath& suggested_path) {
    DCHECK_CURRENTLY_ON(BrowserThread::UI);

    base::FilePath file_name = suggested_path.BaseName();
    file_name = file_name.ReplaceExtension(FILE_PATH_LITERAL(".crdownload"));

    callback.Run(
        suggested_path,
        download_id,
        DownloadItem::TARGET_DISPOSITION_OVERWRITE,
        DownloadTargetCallback::DangerType::DANGEROUS_FILE,
        file_name,
        suggested_path,
        DownloadItem::TARGETDisposition::TARGET_DISPOSITION_OVERWRITE,
        base::FilePath(),
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        base::Time::Now(),
        DownloadTargetCallback::CompleteInfo(),
        content::DownloadItem::DOWNLOAD_DANGER_TYPE_NOT_DANGEROUS,
        false,
        false,
        DownloadTargetCallback::DownloadTargetCallbackExtraInfo());
}
